# README feature pictures

These pictures illustrate the feature sections of the root `README.md`. They're AVIF files: stills, plus animated loops for taste, imports, AI, and Discord. Animated AVIF is several times smaller than animated WebP or GIF for this footage.

- **Sources:** Most scenes are built from the start page intro film's parts (`goodwatch-webapp/app/ui/living-room/intro/`). The episodes grid is a screenshot of a show page on goodwatch.app.
- **Re-rendering:** The scene harness and recorders are on the branch `prototype/readme-animations`, in `goodwatch-webapp/app/ui/prototype-readme/` and `.github/readme/scenes/`.
- **Descriptions:** The summary table near the top of the root `README.md` gives each feature one short sentence. The "A closer look" section shows each picture next to a heading and one or two longer sentences. The layout variants that led to this design are on the branch `prototype/readme-layout`. For earlier formatting research, see [`docs/research/readme-description-formatting.md`](../../../docs/research/readme-description-formatting.md).
